name: CV-PORTAL
description: Constrained optimization problems are common in real-world applications, and benchmark suites are important for analyzing algorithm behavior. However, many existing benchmarks are based on fixed problem formulations and provide limited control over structural properties. This paper proposes CV-PORTAL, a controllable benchmark generator for constrained optimization. Built on PORTAL, CV-PORTAL constructs threshold, exclusion, and ring constraints from PORTAL components, enabling control over feasible-region size, distribution, and discreteness for generating constrained problems with tunable complexity and challenges.
